packageRules.description: Everything except Fleet: stable releases only (no RC, beta, or other prerelease tags).

Fleet follows the release-candidate channel: the newest of stable (vX.Y.Z) and RC (rc-minor-fleet-vX.Y.Z / rc-patch-fleet-vX.Y.Z) tags. RCs count as prereleases of the same version, so a stable release supersedes its own RC. Docker Hub's `latest` tag follows stable only, so respectLatest is off or it would cap updates at the latest stable and hide newer RCs. The fleet-migrate pre-deploy job migrates the database before the new version serves traffic.

Authentik refuses to start if a release line (2026.2, 2026.5, 2026.8, ...) is skipped. Within a year, one PR per release line; merge them oldest first, one at a time. Year changes (Renovate major) cannot be split per line, and would offer the new year's newest line, so they wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard: step through each line of the new year by hand.
prBodyNotes: **Authentik upgrades must go one release line at a time.** If another Authentik PR for an older release line is open, merge that one first and wait until Authentik is healthy. Skipping a line makes Authentik crash-loop with `Major version skips are not allowed` (see do/README.md, Updates).
